claims.claim: A draw takes the top card of the player's own deck into that player's hand.
Multiple draws are repeated single-card draws.
A deck-to-hand move not instructed as a draw is not automatically a draw.
Draw replacement and draw-trigger timing exist and require future hooks.
An empty-deck draw may be attempted; normally no card is drawn.
Deck-empty game termination is a separate follow-up concern for full stabilization.

scopeLimit: Base DRAW semantics only; this does not claim replacement, trigger, or stabilization support.
